in_marathi.name: Khemraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of creation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khemraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Khemraj is derived from two Sanskrit words, ‘Khema’ meaning 'earth' and ‘Raj’ meaning 'king' or 'ruler'. This name signifies the creator of the universe and the one who rules over it.
